title: DOW-UAP-PR22, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, July 2022
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the Department of War regarding a UAP sighting in Syria on July 31, 2022, containing heavy redactions under 1.4(a) and FOIA exemptions.

incidents.summary: An unidentified aerial phenomenon was observed moving from north to south in less than a minute.
incidents.quote: THE UAP OCCURED IN LESS THAN A MINUTE, WITH THE UAP MOVING FROM N TO S.
